answer: An agent network curbs Sybil attacks via optical wavefront attestation. Each node directs coherent light through a photonic lantern onto a lotus diffraction mask, verifying spatial mode distributions within a strict time horizon. Because photonic wave mixing cannot be simulated in software, an adversary must deploy discrete optical transceivers per identity, incurring real hardware costs. However, ambient thermal drift distorts optical phase coherence, occasionally causing false rejections.
